label: 事後の感度
label_text: 事後の感度：凍結した A・B・C の結果（outputs/abc）を見た後、2026-11-07 に定めた。計算の前に定めた比較ではなく、凍結の結果を置き換えない

changes_after_registration.kind: clarification of the policy-change count, decided after all 432 abc_posthoc runs had been solved and their counts seen
changes_after_registration.registered: posthoc.report lists 'policy changes' and 'paths with a policy change' without saying which comparison counts as a change
changes_after_registration.before: policy_changed = the flag of rolling.switch (as in abc_switches.csv): the policy forms from t_k are compared as they are, so a subsidy map that has no year from t_k on counts as a map
changes_after_registration.after: policy_changed_effective = the same comparison with the subsidy map reduced to its non-zero entries (abc_posthoc.effective_policy). The reported counts use it
changes_after_registration.reason: rolling.switch reports a change when R3 switches off a subsidy map at a review after the last subsidy year of the B rule, although no payment changes. rolling.py is not changed (it is in the solve-cache fingerprint), so the effective flag is computed in abc_posthoc.py
changes_after_registration.effect: no solve and no cost, CO2 or C' - B' value changes; only the counts. Variants with a policy change: 8 (before) -> 6 (after). Per variant (before -> after): R3-P4300 18 -> 6, R3-P7000 12 -> 0, R3-P10000 6 -> 0, R4-nocert-P10000 8 -> 2 (its R3 6 -> 0; R4 2 unchanged). The frozen run (P* = 0, no subsidy map) is unaffected
changes_after_registration.results_before_kept: posthoc_summary.csv columns R*_policy_changed, n_policy_changed, n_paths_policy_changed, paths_policy_changed; posthoc_summary.json n_variants_with_policy_change; posthoc_switches.csv column policy_changed

common: frozen rules (abc.rules_check()), the same 18 realization paths, review years 2026 / 2030 / 2035, certificates on (only the R4 variant without certificates). Every variant solves B' (adaptive false) and C' (adaptive true) with the same settings; the effect is C' - B' per path

rule_conditions.R3: R3 sets the subsidy of the next stage to 0 when the observed price >= P*. The B rule pays the subsidy only in years whose base-path price < P*, so C' differs from B' only when the observed price at t_k - 1 is >= P* while the B rule still pays in the next stage
rule_conditions.R1: changes policy only if phi_0 < 1 and the observed liquid share of new capacity < liquid_review[t_k]
rule_conditions.R2: changes policy only if T_g > t_k and the observed connection usage >= the threshold
rule_conditions.R4: changes policy only if emissions exceed the cap path and some build is subsidized

A_reference: frozen A of abc_metrics.csv (certificates on); C' - A is not reported for the variant without certificates
policy_change_note: policy_changed = the flag of rolling.switch (as in abc_switches.csv); policy_changed_effective = the same comparison with the subsidy map reduced to its non-zero entries (effective_policy). They differ only for R3 at a review after the last subsidy year of the B rule, where switching the subsidy off changes no payment; the results use the effective flag

frozen.name: frozen
frozen.reason: reference; B' and C' must equal B and C of abc_metrics.csv (rel 1e-9)

R1-phi0_8.name: R1-phi0.8
R1-phi0_8.reason: R1 raises phi by 0.2; the frozen phi_0 = 1.0 is the cap and leaves no room. One step of room
R1-phi0_8.value_status: assumption (仮定; one and two steps of the frozen rule increment 0.2)
